evals.prompt: afk mode is on. In the wordcount project (a scratch copy of evals/files/wordcount), fix the bug where running the script on an empty file crashes, then report back following the afk contract.
evals.expected_output: The bug is fixed, the test passes, and the closing update follows the afk output contract for a project with no UI.
expectations: The update leads with the outcome in one or two sentences
The update states in a single line that the project renders no UI so there is no preview URL, with no retry loop around tailscale
The update reports the verification command and its pass or fail result
The diff summary lists each changed file as path:line with the resulting behavior, not the mechanics of the edit
The update ends with a closed question offering likely next actions
No part of the update points to a file path or command output as the answer

evals.prompt: afk mode is on and this prompt arrived by voice dictation: "ok so the read me still says the install command is npm install dash g but we moved to pnpm cash the docs are wrong fix the get hub badge too its pointing at the old workflow". The project is a scratch copy of evals/files/readme-project.
evals.expected_output: The README install command is corrected to pnpm, the stale badge is fixed, and the reply notes how the garbled dictation was interpreted.
expectations: The reply maps the dictation artifacts to real intent, for example reading "get hub" as GitHub, without asking for clarification
The reply notes the interpretation in passing so a wrong guess is caught at a glance
The README install instructions are changed from npm -g to the pnpm equivalent
The stale workflow badge is updated to the current workflow path
The closing update follows the afk contract: outcome first, verification, diff summary, closed question

evals.prompt: Attended run only, it starts a dev server and tailscale serve listeners. /afk in a Vite or Next.js project checkout: run the preview bootstrap and reply with the live URL and a one-line ready message.
evals.expected_output: A reachable tailnet HTTPS URL pointing at this checkout's dev server, obtained via CertDomains, with listeners reused or created per the skill and torn down on /afk off.
expectations: The hostname comes from tailscale status --json CertDomains, falling back to Self.DNSName plus --http only when CertDomains is empty
An existing serve mapping to the right port is reused and mappings this session did not create are never repointed
The URL is labeled with the branch or worktree name when more than one checkout is live
On /afk off only listeners this session added are turned off and the dev server is left running

evals.prompt: Attended run only, it commits and pushes. With afk mode on in a scratch repository with a remote and uncommitted work, the user sends: "ship".
evals.expected_output: Exactly commit, push, and open request, then a link with a one-line summary; nothing beyond those three steps.
expectations: The commit follows the repository's commit convention
The push and request use the CLI matching the origin remote, with the compare URL fallback when neither gh nor glab is installed
No merge, no force push, and no action beyond commit, push, and open request
The reply is the link plus a one-line summary
